The '''Imperial Veterans Association''' was a veteran's affairs organization dedicated to those who had served in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. In particular, the organization hoped to uphold the memory of those who were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in its service.<ref name="Battle of Endor" />
